## Line 81

```plato

//==
// # Smoothing weights

// How a Laplacian step weights the neighbours of a vertex
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laplacian_smoothing). UniformWeights gives every
// neighbour the same say, which is cheap and drifts vertices along the surface;
// CotangentWeights uses the cotangent formula, which discretizes the
// Laplace-Beltrami operator and so depends on the shape rather than on the
// triangulation (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discrete_Laplace_operator).
type LaplacianWeighting = UniformWeights | CotangentWeights;
```
